override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Blind second read of the kit prose only. S1 = hitCount:10 self ATK ▲23.15% ×5 stacks / 5s (stacks lapse across the 159f reload, so steady-state is BELOW 5 — the engine resolves this naturally, no ramp authored). S1's Current HP ▼4.01% is unmodeled (no HP pool in v1) but is LOAD-BEARING: it is the mechanism that opens S2's HP<60% gate and the burst's HP<50% gate. Derivation of the gate timings from the kit alone (self-damage only, a floor — boss damage only speeds it up): current-HP decay is multiplicative, 0.9599^n, so HP<60% at n=13 procs (=130 landed rounds) and HP<50% at n=17 procs (=170 rounds). At ~12 pulls/s with a 20-round magazine + 159f reload that is ≈4.6 rounds/s → HP<60% at ≈28s, HP<50% at ≈37s. S2's Crit Damage ▲6.61% 'continuously' is therefore authored as a passive with rampSec:56 — a linear ramp over 2T has the same time-integral as a step at T, so 56 is the equal-integral proxy for the ~28s step. The burst's 10s Crit Rate window cannot use rampSec (its clock would start at the cast frame, ramping WITHIN the window), so it is authored ungated at full value and flagged as an early-burst over-credit. Burst nuke 849.15% authored crit-eligible, no core (the text says no core strike), noFb per the burst-cast FB-exemption rule. noRange left unset (engine-automatic).

flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #1 (cadence tuple, datamine-unreliable). The hitCount:10 trigger frequency, the 5-stack steady state, and BOTH derived HP-gate timings all scale inversely with true rounds/sec. It also assumes every fired round LANDS (a miss rate stretches all three).
flags.recipe: Read shots/sec directly off the ammo counter in a scarlet recording (the instrument that measures the disputed quantity), not off FB counts; confirm the reload wall-clock from the same footage. Then recompute rounds/s and re-derive the 130-round / 170-round gate times.

flags.reasoning: The HP trajectory IS kit-stated (prior #10: derive when start+consume are stated): 4.01% of CURRENT HP per S1 proc → 0.9599^n; 0.9599^13=0.587<0.60 (n=12 gives 0.612), so HP<60% at 13 procs = 130 landed rounds ≈28s. A linear 0→full ramp over R has the same time-integral as a step at R/2, so R=56 reproduces the correct time-averaged contribution for any fight ≳56s — but NOT the correct shape (it credits some crit damage before 28s and reaches full only at 56s).
flags.recipe: If an HP pool ever lands, replace rampSec with a real HP-threshold gate. Until then: count S1 buffApply events to the first 13th proc in a run (harness onEvent, stat atkPct, key = S1's) and set rampSec = 2× that timestamp. Boss damage to scarlet in the real fight only makes 28s an UPPER bound.
